body:
## Expected Behavior

I add the same custom search attribute to a namespace from multiple containers almost at the same time. I expect to have only one custom search attribute (with the alias I provided) 

## Actual Behavior

Temporal creates multiple search attributes with the same alias (probably, because of race condition). This leads to multiple problems with queries to the visibility database.

## Steps to Reproduce the Problem

This bash script adds the same custom search attribute 5 times in parallel:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -u

NAMESPACE="${NAMESPACE:-default}"
ATTR_NAME="${ATTR_NAME:-RaceTestAttr}"
ADDRESS="${TEMPORAL_ADDRESS:-127.0.0.1:7233}"

add_attr() {
    local id=$1
    echo "[worker-$id] starting"
    temporal operator search-attribute create \
        --address "$ADDRESS" \
        --namespace "$NAMESPACE" \
        --name "$ATTR_NAME" \
        --type Keyword \
        2>&1 | sed "s/^/[worker-$id] /"
    echo "[worker-$id] exit=$?"
}

echo "Firing 5 concurrent adds of '$ATTR_NAME' (Keyword) on namespace '$NAMESPACE'..."
add_attr 1 &
add_attr 2 &
add_attr 3 &
add_attr 4 &
add_attr 5 &
wait
```

After running this script, I see the following `CustomSearchAttributeAliases` (some search attribute aliases are omitted from output):

```
temporal operator namespace describe --namespace default

  NamespaceInfo.Name                    default
  NamespaceInfo.Id                      3eb73ba4-a7d9-4ccb-8853-f32aa15554ad
  NamespaceInfo.Description              
  NamespaceInfo.OwnerEmail               
  NamespaceInfo.State                   Registered
  NamespaceInfo.Data                    map[]
  Config.WorkflowExecutionRetentionTtl  720h0m0s
  ReplicationConfig.ActiveClusterName   active
  ReplicationConfig.Clusters            [{"clusterName":"active"}]
  ReplicationConfig.State               Normal
  Config.HistoryArchivalState           Disabled
  Config.VisibilityArchivalState        Disabled
  IsGlobalNamespace                     false
  FailoverVersion                       0
  FailoverHistory                       []
  Config.HistoryArchivalUri              
  Config.VisibilityArchivalUri           
  Config.CustomSearchAttributeAliases   map[... Keyword02:RaceTestAttr ... Keyword04:RaceTestAttr...]
```

## Specifications

  - Version: 1.29.1
  - Platform: self-hosted in k8s using Temporal Helm chart

comments.body: Thanks for filing this issue! I was able to confirm this is an issue offline and have opened a fix. The issue is just due to missing optimistic concurrency control checks: https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/10057/changes. You can expect this to be patched in the release of v1.32.0.
@awln-temporal Awesome, thank you! Looking forward for the release!

title: Multiple custom search attributes with the same alias
